turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: I’ve been having intense itching on my right thigh for the past few days, and I’ve noticed red bumps in the same area. It’s also started on my left leg and right forearm, and I’ve been scratching enough to leave some excoriations. I recently traveled to Miami for a business conference.

turns.doctor_question: Have you or someone noticed any times when your breathing stops or you stop breathing for short periods during sleep (for example, pauses that last several seconds)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, my breathing during sleep hasn’t been noticed to stop or pause, and I haven’t had anyone tell me that I stop breathing for a few seconds.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury or fall, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—like severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any fall or injury, and I haven’t noticed severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using any area. It’s mainly the intense itching and red bumps that have been spreading to my left leg and right forearm.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist**? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any specific redness or warmth on my left wrist—mainly the itchy red bumps are on my right thigh, left leg, and my right forearm.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the chest), especially after an injury or from coughing/strain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall, and I haven’t had any injury or significant coughing or straining recently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed urinating much more than usual—no increased frequency or larger amounts. My main issue has been the spreading intense itching with red bumps on my right thigh, left leg, and right forearm.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids (including prescription pain pills), stimulants, or other drugs?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t use alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or any other drugs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or needing to rush to the bathroom and not making it in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine—no leaking and no rushing or accidents. It’s mainly the spreading intense itching and the red bumps with scratching on my right thigh, left leg, and right forearm.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even if they were mild or only a few drops)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds recently, even mild ones. It’s only been the intense itching and red bumps spreading across my right thigh, left leg, and right forearm.”
